purpose: SECOND TASK FAMILY for the decisive-recipe replication (owner-approved 2026-07-19). Replays the real VextrumDataFlow pipeline-core era 9570b0b^..081b23d (8 commits, ~190 churn across FOUR modules): before-state materialization crashes on misaligned SQL params and, when it ran, swept all of UDS every run; the after-state adds watermarked incremental materialization, two-database routing (UDS on its own connection), and configuration-aware resume that reuses succeeded steps. Differs from vextrum-era-v3-gen4 on every axis that matters: repo, domain (DB-backed orchestration vs PDF rendering), MULTI-MODULE task (4 files), and a psycopg2-level stub so any reshaping of the db seam executes for real - routing is observed at the true seam (connection DSN), not at a function-name surface. Grader is GEN-4 from birth (relational predicates + count-equal for state-write kinds where the altformat variant agrees exactly).

local_source.altformat_note: The altformat variant advances the watermark via UPDATE-then-INSERT instead of a single upsert - a genuinely different-but-valid write pattern. It kills exact-count pinning on the watermark write while presence (became-nonzero) survives; the stub normalizes all watermark writes to one event kind so the verb choice itself is never graded.

interpretation: Underspecified-by-design at scale, across modules: a symptom-level incident list plus discoverable operational conventions covering an 8-commit rework of four cooperating modules. Every graded family is anchored to a CONVENTIONS.md sentence. Score moves in steps of ~14 (7 families). HONEST CAVEATS to publish with any result: the db stub emulates the %s contract and canned per-table state, not SQL semantics - the planner's pending-record SELECTION lives in SQL the stub deliberately serves permissively, so planner selection quality is UNGRADED AND NAMED; UDS filter pushdown is likewise served permissively and ungraded; retry capping (FAILED >= 3) is ungraded for the same reason. An implementation that abandons psycopg2 or invents tables the stub does not know fails as a totality finding - the psycopg2 seam and the schema are declared workspace facts, and CONVENTIONS pins the paramstyle.
